rationale: The agency emailed the tenant for a photo of the solar panel reading (006), and on the follow-up call the tenant agreed to send one (008). The agency held awaiting photos (009), chased four days later (010), and received and forwarded the photo the same day (012, 013). A dated follow-up is right; a short written reminder is also acceptable. Closing before the reading arrives, or sending a contractor for a meter photo, is wrong.
